Technology for the smallest farms.

TIGA — Technology Assessment and Farm Household Segmentation for Inclusive Poverty Reduction

Ex-ante impact assessment and farm-household segmentation for inclusive technology adoption, with baseline and endline surveys and RCT design support, for the Gates Foundation.

Role
specialist
Period
Jan 2012 – Jan 2013
Geography
Bangladesh
Status
Delivered
B26Pillars demonstratedEDTREconomics × Data stories × Technology × Research

What I did.

  1. Assessed (ex-ante) the likely impact of major agricultural crop innovations and productivity growth programs on workforce productivity and livelihoods across strata of the poor.
  2. Developed a rollout strategy for major innovations based on the assessment.
  3. Designed project interventions and MRM systems; prepared questionnaires and methodology for baseline and endline surveys; conducted survey and data analysis.
  4. Presented at an international seminar and co-authored a book chapter.
  5. Supported the team leader in designing a 4-year intervention programme using RCT methodology with ZEF, University of Bonn.

The assignment.

Enhance the inclusion of all small farming communities in agricultural technology innovation by improving understanding of the interactions between technology needs, farming systems, ecological resources and poverty characteristics.
